[EN] The first time I saw this vessel, there were only five soldiers on board. Not only is there a storm rolling in, but it looks like two full pirate crews coming at us.

I don't know who else is on board, but you'd better get ready. Five soldiers are no match for this many opponents.Defeat all enemies within the time limit to receive additional rewards.
[ES] La primera vez que vi esta nave, solo había cinco soldados a bordo. No solo se avecina una tormenta, sino que parece que dos tripulaciones piratas completas vienen hacia nosotros.

No sé quién más está a bordo, pero más vale que te prepares. Cinco soldados no son rival para tantos oponentes.Derrota a todos los enemigos dentro del tiempo límite para recibir recompensas adicionales.
